findings.quote: distinguish twelve expected rows from thirteen pinned inputs.
findings.why: The rule names no file, and the thirteen inputs it counts are not the inputs of either manifest the recipe's commands name: both .ufo/evidence/round-14/dispositions.json and dispositions-before.json carry twelve rows but only three `inputs` entries (all still matching at C0), so the count resolves only in the referenced .ufo/evidence/round-13/expected.json (expected_checks 12, inputs 13), which the sentence never names.

findings.quote: their pinned inputs moved after round 14
findings.why: The two round-14 manifests' own pinned inputs did not move: all three digests in each manifest's `inputs` map still match at C0, and the three stale pins sit in the referenced .ufo/evidence/round-13/expected.json, so the sentence attributes the moved pins to the manifests that merely point at them.
